card.name: The word maximum in dose caps
card.fires_on: The word "maximum" (capitalized or not) when it introduces a dose limit, usually in parentheses right after a per-kg dose or at the start of a sentence about daily dose.

modes.label: Parenthetical cap after per-kg dose
modes.description: "maximum" opens a parenthesis that gives an upper amount after a mg/kg dose.

modes.label: Sentence-initial Maximum
modes.description: Capitalized "Maximum" starts a sentence or heading about the dose limit.

card.writes: It adds little beyond a vague push toward words about choices or allowable limits.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "maximum" when a label gives the top amount for a dose.
